record.house_tang.genealogy.title: House Tang Genealogical Register
facts: House Tang family lineage and recognized household relationships are recorded here.
Recognized succession claims are cross-referenced to the current household register.

record.house_tang.land_deeds.title: House Tang Land and Holding Deeds
facts: Sword Manor is a private House Tang estate inside Luoyang.
House Tang agricultural acreage is held outside the urban manor compound.

record.house_tang.accounts.title: House Tang Accounts and Contract Register
facts: Faction treasury, current enterprises and conserved contract obligations are reconciled through the House accounts.
Commercial records do not substitute for physical market stock or cash.

record.central_plain.route_maps.title: Central Plain Route and Caravan Maps
facts: The maps record known roads, crossings, major settlements and ordinary caravan routes in the Central Plain.
A map does not reveal a current outlaw ambush or traveler position unless a current report has added that information.

record.house_tang.medical_reference.title: House Tang Medical Reference
facts: The collection covers wound stabilization, bone care, internal injury support and the five recognized toxin families.
Its recipes use the game's abstract medicinal materials and do not encode hidden patient truth.
